header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Select ROM
on a new profile once the shader list Chrome builds behind the launcher is done (Firefox builds none there, and its
line saying so is the one waited for), Start game and the logos (each with Enter, on the launcher's first item: it sits
at the bottom right, where no one click reaches it at every width, and Enter is pressed until the game has started,
since a ROM given takes the focus, which the first key only brings back); then two stages in one load, each behind a need that
fails the run unless g_StageNum is that stage and the menu MENU_RUN_STAGE, its opening flyover skipped with A (until
g_CameraMode is Bond's own view). Dam is started by tools/shader_survey.js as mission select does (MENU_RUN_STAGE
behind the stage's briefing): about 35 s of Bond on foot, walking down the road and back, turning, strafing and
firing. Then Facility (indoors, from the vent), started from inside Dam by the survey's nextStage (the stage's
briefing, then g_MainStageNum, which ends the stage loop as a stage's end does, with no report between): about 25 s of
Bond walking out and back by as much about where it starts him, strafing, firing and turning. Its waits and holds are
on the game's own clock, g_GlobalTimer (60ths of a second), so every browser walks Bond as far whatever frames it
gives the game. Bond is made invincible once each stage has started (setInvincible): a stage started that way crashes
when it ends (patches/shader_survey.c), and Dam played long enough for the guards to kill him did, the Mission Failed
screen loading a briefing mission select never set up. tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to two more stages, for
when a longer play is needed.
